<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>set</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Masking Monetary Fields</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onLoad() {
    applyLiveMask('v_receita_primaria_total');
    applyLiveMask('v_despesa_primaria_total');
    applyLiveMask('v_resultado_primario_receita_despesa');
}

function applyLiveMask(variableName) {
    var field = g_form.getControl(variableName);
    if (!field) return;

    field.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
        let raw = field.value.replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
        if (!raw) {
            field.value = '';
            return;
        }
        let number = parseFloat(raw) / 100;
        let formatted = number.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {
            style: 'currency',
            currency: 'BRL'
        });
        field.value = formatted;
        field.setSelectionRange(formatted.length, formatted.length);
    });

    field.addEventListener('paste', function(e) {
        let pasted = (e.clipboardData || window.clipboardData).getData('text');
        if (/[^\d]/.test(pasted.replace(/[^\d]/g, ''))) {
            e.preventDefault();
        }
    });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>javier.rodriguez@artycs.com.br</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-11-19 18:18:10</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>17bd1af9fbd93e1086e7f4045eefdc3f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Masking Monetary Fields</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Portal Tesouro" source="x_sded9_portal_t_0">724414a2fb192a1086e7f4045eefdcf8</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Portal Tesouro">724414a2fb192a1086e7f4045eefdcf8</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_17bd1af9fbd93e1086e7f4045eefdc3f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>javier.rodriguez@artycs.com.br</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-11-19 18:18:10</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onLoad</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set display_value="Ranking Data">03f516fdfb993e1086e7f4045eefdc68</variable_set><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
